raster_review.scope: Independent direct three-sheet review completed before SVG: pink/purple smooth cyanoxantha alternatives; pale lamellae and stem, no ring, volva or reticulum. Schematic aggregate, not organism identification.

anatomy.description: Schema dell’alternativa rosa liscia del gruppo virescens/cyanoxantha. Cappello convesso, lamelle chiare; fungo intero con gambo chiaro senza anello, volva o reticolo. Non identificazione di organismo.
anatomy.annotation_method: Manual regions fitted separately to the approved r03 raster crops; real boolean-intersected paint paths, no automatic anatomy inference.

parts.label: Gambo
parts.meaning: Gambo chiaro visibile. Nessun anello, volva o reticolo nel raster o nei valori documentati.

parts.label: Cappello liscio
parts.meaning: Alternativa cromatica liscia coerente con cyanoxantha nei traits_notes dell’aggregato; non aggiungere il mosaico di virescens.
parts.source_path_selection_note: Manually reviewed pink/purple cap paint stack added to an interior boundary polygon. Pale gill and stem paints excluded; dark shared boundary is split graphically.

parts.label: Lamelle
parts.meaning: Lamelle chiare schematiche; nessun poro o piega sostitutivo, nessun conteggio quantitativo.

limitations: Aggregate illustrated alternatives do not assert every trait coexists in one organism.
Smooth pink/purple alternative follows cyanoxantha notes; do not transfer virescens mosaic.
Hiding parts can expose transparent gaps. No hidden tissue reconstruction.
Technical tint is not an approved biological color variant.

author: Fronda/Fungaroli
geometry: Source paint stacks intersected into actual anatomical part geometries; no raster, masks, clips or complete-object copies. Graphic underpaint retained inside each part to preserve antialiasing, not reconstructed hidden tissue.
unsupported: quantitative organ counts from illustrative marks
